fixes.fix: Table(persist_empty=True) cleared existing documents of the table
fixes.why: Reopening a table with persist_empty=True silently wiped all stored documents (data loss).
fixes.upstream_commit: 717616b fix: persist_empty must not wipe existing table data (#642)

fixes.fix: Class-level default_query_cache_capacity override ignored (default arg bound at def time)
fixes.why: docs/extend.rst tells users to set TinyDB.table_class.default_query_cache_capacity, which had no effect.

fixes.fix: remove(doc_ids=[1,1]) raised KeyError on duplicate IDs
fixes.why: Duplicate IDs in the list crashed the removal with KeyError.

fixes.fix: update(..., doc_ids=[1,1]) applied the transform twice and reported the ID twice
fixes.why: increment with a duplicated ID incremented twice - wrong result.

fixes.fix: update_multiple with a generator of updates only applied it to the first document
fixes.why: Signature accepts Iterable, but a one-shot iterable was exhausted after the first document, so later documents were not updated.

fixes.fix: update_multiple returned the same doc ID multiple times when several conditions matched
fixes.why: Returned ID list contained duplicates; arguably wrong but harmless, and a maintainer could see it as per-update reporting.

fixes.fix: insert_multiple with an explicit Document ID followed by plain dicts reused/collided IDs; stale _next_id after explicit IDs
fixes.why: Auto-generated ID could overwrite the just-inserted explicit-ID document (data loss) or later insert raised ValueError.
fixes.upstream_commit: bd034d0 fix: don't reuse IDs in mixed insert_multiple batches (#633)

fixes.fix: insert() with a stale cached next ID (file modified by another TinyDB instance) raised ValueError; now picks a free ID
fixes.why: Concurrent multi-instance access to one file is not supported by TinyDB; auto-healing is a policy choice.

fixes.fix: search() results shared Document objects with the query cache; mutating a result corrupted later searches (now shallow-copies documents)
fixes.why: Upstream explicitly declined to fix this for performance reasons and documented it as a caveat; agent's shallow copy protects only top-level keys and adds per-search copying cost.
fixes.upstream_commit: 8d3f0c7 docs: document that search() results share structure with the query cache (#617) - upstream chose to document, not fix

fixes.fix: Query cache not cleared when an updater raises mid-way (in-place modifications leave stale cache)
fixes.why: Only matters after a failed update that already partially mutated MemoryStorage data in place; the underlying non-atomic update remains, so this is an edge-case consistency tweak.

fixes.fix: TinyDB.__getattr__ infinite recursion on copy.copy / uninitialized instance
fixes.why: copy.copy(db) raised RecursionError.

fixes.fix: Middleware.__getattr__ raised KeyError instead of AttributeError when uninitialized
fixes.why: hasattr()/copy/pickle on an uninitialized middleware crashed with KeyError, violating the __getattr__ protocol.

fixes.fix: touch(create_dirs=True) failed for a bare filename (empty dirname); also exist_ok for races
fixes.why: TinyDB('db.json', create_dirs=True) raised FileNotFoundError from os.makedirs('').
fixes.upstream_commit: 59ee593 fix: prevent FileNotFoundError when storages.touch() is called with a file in current directory (#619)

fixes.fix: JSONStorage write in binary access mode (rb+) wrote str to a binary handle (TypeError)
fixes.why: access_mode='rb+' is explicitly allowed but every write crashed.

fixes.fix: Regex flags not part of matches()/search() query hash, so cache returned wrong results
fixes.why: A case-insensitive query hit the cache entry of the case-sensitive one - wrong results.
fixes.upstream_commit: e83efcd fix: include regex flags in matches/search query hash (#640)

fixes.fix: fragment() hash omitted the query path, so fragments on different fields collided in cache/equality
fixes.why: Query().a.fragment(x) and Query().b.fragment(x) compared equal and shared cached results - wrong results.

fixes.fix: fragment() on a non-mapping field value raised TypeError
fixes.why: Searching with a path fragment crashed if any document had a scalar at that path.

fixes.fix: FrozenDict hash crashed for dicts with mixed-type keys (sorted())
fixes.why: where('a') == {1: 2, 'x': 1} raised TypeError on search.

fixes.fix: Unhashable values in query hashes (comparison rhs lists, Query.test args, nested in tuples) raised TypeError; freeze rhs/args and freeze tuple contents
fixes.why: where('a') < [2] or .test(f, [1]) crashed with 'unhashable type' when used with a Table.
fixes.upstream_commit: 770486f fix: freeze unhashable args in Query.test to prevent TypeError (#618)

fixes.fix: Ordering comparisons against incomparable values (None < 5) raised TypeError; now treated as non-match
fixes.why: Silently swallowing TypeError is a policy choice; a maintainer may prefer the error surface type mismatches.

fixes.fix: one_of() with a generator only worked for the first document
fixes.why: Generator exhausted after first membership test, giving wrong results for later documents.

fixes.fix: any()/all() with a non-cacheable inner query were marked cacheable (and cached)
fixes.why: Different map()-based inner queries hashed equal (None) so the cache returned another query's results.

fixes.fix: Non-cacheable queries (hash None) compared equal to each other
fixes.why: (Query().map(f) == 1) == (Query().map(g) == 2) was True; wrong equality semantics.

fixes.fix: Query.__getattr__ treated dunder lookups as field paths, breaking copy.deepcopy/pickle
fixes.why: copy.deepcopy(Query().a) raised RuntimeError.

fixes.fix: LRUCache treated stored None values as missing
fixes.why: cache['a'] = None then cache['a'] raised KeyError.
fixes.upstream_commit: 19066e0 fix: fix LRUCache treating stored None values as missing (#635)

fixes.fix: Table.get(cond) re-read the table instead of using the already-read copy
fixes.why: Redundant storage read only; no observable behaviour change and no test.
